[CR CR0026 for 38.455] Reason for change: NRPPa section 9.0 is referring to TS 38.413, while section 10 is referring to chapter 10 of 36.455, which in turn refers to 36.413. This leads to possible confusion. Summary of change: Revision of section 10 to have the correct reference to TS 38.413. Added description in case of Abstract Syntax Error. Added description in case of Logical Error. Impact analysis: Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release): This CR has an impact under protocol point of view. The impact can be considered isolated because the change affects only the NRPPa section 10 description. Consequences if not approved: The integrity of TS 38 series is not respected.
